author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at the complete death of the physical game market in less than a week. Playstation has now said they will no longer make discs, I can imagine the other companies will follow sadly. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: No More Physical Playstation Discs Anymore...
